label: Lapel
description: Contrast lapel facings replace the outer cloth on both lapel faces with a different material — typically a contrasting colour, weight, or texture such as a matte wool against a tweed body — creating a visual frame around the jacket's chest opening that draws the eye to the lapel shape. This is a device used in both fashion-forward bespoke commissions and in traditional sporting jackets, where a plain solid-colour lapel on a patterned body (or vice versa) can read the shape of the lapel more clearly. Well executed, it requires careful pattern matching at the lapel seam and demands precise canvassing to ensure the facing lies flat without puckering.
